selection.scope: Train-only descriptive source-record matching. Source classifications and administrative states are used for matching only, not added to predictive inputs; their acquisition times are unverified. No causal interpretation.
selection.sort: largest matched group, earliest target date, then lexical household IDs; no target values used directly for ranking

unverified: Resident counts and floor areas are not collected in these source profiles.
Device count/power/use and precise location are incomplete.
Shared product and event do not verify equal numeric rates.
Separate customer IDs and different meter series do not independently establish distinct physical dwellings.
